4222-6006-8299.description:
Activate Hemmer by tapping it, adding {U}.
Hemmer triggers, causing you to loot
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Hemmer.
Repeat.

7084-8250-8293.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.

2556-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
2556-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
2556-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Mnemonic Wall and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

141-6476-8095.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-6476-8095.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2073-2099-7880.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Elven Bow from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Elven Bow enters, it triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token and attach Elven Bow to it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Elven Bow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
When the Elf Warrior dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

678-4050-4151-7824.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
678-4050-4151-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
678-4050-4151-7824.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2350-4399-4518-7818.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Stone Calendar.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2350-4399-4518-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

79-3055-3953-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Birthing Hulk, adding {W}.
When Birthing Hulk dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Birthing Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Birthing Hulk enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Birthing Hulk.
Repeat.

413-2577-7390.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
5686-6972-7228.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3525-6788-7290.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-6788-7290.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-6788-7290.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-3488-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Katsumasa.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1739-2060-2908-6930.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

586-997-1472-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-997-1472-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

261-3490-4050-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2099-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

826-3767-3918-4851.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2743-2959-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-2959-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-2959-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Heat Shimmer at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Heat Shimmer spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

1722-1808-2034-6625.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

1947-3327-4381-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4381-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1436-2825.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-2825.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Call to Glory and casting the copy without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

586-997-2906-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
586-997-2906-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1308-4559-4740-5670.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
1308-4559-4740-5670.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

364-3098-3449-5195.description:
Cast Déjà Vu by paying {U}, targeting Call to Mind.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Déjà Vu, returning Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {U}, targeting Déjà Vu.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Call to Mind, returning Déjà Vu from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Liliana, Heretical Healer // Liliana, Defiant Necromancer

2533-2945-3605-4050-5006.notablePrerequisites:
Lurrus and You have not cast a spell using Lurrus this turn.
It is your precombat main phase.
2533-2945-3605-4050-5006.description:
Cast Dance of the Dead from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}, returning Liliana, Heretical Healer from your graveyard to the battlefield with Dance of the Dead attached.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {B}.
When Lurrus dies, Liliana, Heretical Healer triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Liliana, Defiant Necromancer, and create a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {1}.
Activate Liliana, Defiant Necromancer's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it.
Liliana dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Liliana ability, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1242-1323-2987.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Channeler Initiate and Cinderhaze Wretch have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
1242-1323-2987.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on Experiment Kraj, untapping Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Channeler Initiate's ability by tapping Experiment Kraj and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

500-1181-2556.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mnemonic Wall and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The two Mnemonic Wall tokens enter the battlefield, returning Sacrifice, if applicable, and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Mnemonic Wall token, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead return any other instant or sorcery that can be cast using only black mana in place of Sacrifice using the Mnemonic Wall tokens to get infinite casts of those instants and/or sorceries.

822-4694-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-4694-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-4694-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat
